programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19
programme.desc: From the Barockschloss in Rammenau the Gewandhaus-Quartett plays Mozart’s String Quartet No. 19 in C-major, KV. 465. This work is nicknamed 'Dissonance' due to its unusual slow introduction with dissonant notes before the harmony resolving in the key of C-major, starting the bright Allegro section.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 4 in D major, K. 218. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Telemann - Der am Ölberg zagende Jesus, TWV 1: 364
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach & Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Concerto for Orchestra
programme.desc: Watch the series ‘Discovering Masterpieces’, your audio-visual concert guide to the great masterpieces of classical music. The series brings you 20 half-hour documentaries on 20 classical masterpieces: acclaimed experts, famous soloists and outstanding conductors take you on a journey back to the time and place of composition. In today’s documentary, Bela Bartok’s ‘Concerto for Orchestra’ is discussed.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Monteverdi - Madrigals, Book III
programme.desc: Italian composer Claudio Monteverdi (1567-1643) composed nine books of madrigals in half a century, which helped transform the genre from the polyphonic, a cappella madrigals of the late Renaissance to the ‘concertato’ madrigals of the early Baroque, shifting the style’s focus to the ability of music to express emotions contained in a text.

programme.title: England, my England - II
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht was all about 'England, my England'. In line with this theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer on an intriguing journey through the England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major, K. 216. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Alessandro Scarlatti
programme.desc: At the age of 24, following his successes in Rome, Alessandro Scarlatti was appointed royal Kapellmeister in Naples, in 1684. There he had to deal with jealousy and contempt from those involved in the local music scene. Scarlatti came up with the best possible answer to this harassment by enjoying a brilliant career lasting nearly thirty years and producing a phenomenal oeuvre in the process.

programme.title: Cleveland Orchestra - Centennial Celebration
programme.desc: For the Anniversary Gala, Cleveland Orchestra Music Director Franz Welser-Möst led a program featuring pianist Lang Lang as soloist. The program offered works touching on more than a century of Viennese musical traditions with Lang Lang performing Mozart’s Piano Concerto No. 24. The pianist made his Cleveland Orchestra debut in 2000 at Blossom Music Center and most recently performed with the Orchestra in 2014 at Severance Hall.

programme.title: Penderecki - Symphony No. 7: 7 Gates of Jerusalem
programme.desc: The 2017 Prague Spring festival is brought to a powerful close as Krzysztof Penderecki conducts the Prague Radio Symphony Orchestra and Slovak Philharmonic Choir in a performance of his monumental seventh symphony 'Seven Gates of Jerusalem'. This work bears witness to an introspective thought about faith, written in honour of the city of Jerusalem, for soloists, choir and orchestra, with libretto taken from Old Testament.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: Beethoven - Violin Concerto, Op. 61
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Concerto in D major, Op. 61. Leading violinist Grimal is the soloist.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz' Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. This performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21. Soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin. After performing the first concerto, Demidenko encores with Chopin's Mazurka Op. 17/4. Kissin closes the concert with Chopin's Etude Op. 10/12 and the Waltz in E minor, Op. post. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010.

programme.title: Donizetti – L’elisir d’amore
programme.desc: With Rolando Villazón directing and playing the title role, the world rushed for tickets to the Baden-Baden 2012 Pentecost-holiday opera. Following his directorial debut in 2011 (Werther, Lyon) the Mexican tenor went a step further, staging Gaetano Donizetti’s L’elisir d’amore and directing himself in the role of Nemorino.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Charles Mingus And Eric Dolphy live in Liège
programme.desc: Charles Mingus showcases an exceptional concert performed in April 1965 featuring his most celebrated lineup: Jaki Byard (piano), Dannie Richmond (drums), Johnny Coles (trumpet), Clifford Jordan (tenor sax) and the great Eric Dolphy (alto sax, flute and bass clarinet).

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination.

programme.title: Sia - Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: The Australian-born singer-songwriter Sia Kate Isobelle Furler, simply known as Sia, is one of the most unique artists in today's popular music scene. However, her path to stardom has been nothing but rocky. Only after numerous musical experimentations, where the singer tried to establish herself in her home country as well as United Kingdom, Sia finally blossomed in United States around the second decade of the 21st century.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: A Quick Sketch
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sunshine (I Can Fly)
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano & Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: B.B. King: The King of the Blues in Stuttgart
programme.desc: This uptempo, funky performance proves that B.B. King, one of the Masters of the Blues Guitar has still got it. The band features some of today's best blues musicians playing all of B.B. King's classic songs.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: STUFF. live at BIRD Rotterdam
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s BIRD is a club, café, and restaurant with a live music program that's deeply rooted in jazz, soul, funk, hip-hop, and electronic. Its name BIRD refers to the nickname of legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, fine wines, no-nonsense beers, and an all-round metropolitan rawness. Since 2014, this urban jazz club and DJAZZ.

programme.title: Medley
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa’: a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo’.

programme.title: Quartet No. 2 Part 2
programme.desc: Many of pianist Chick Corea’s compositions have become jazz standards. As a member of Miles Davis' band in the late 1960s, he participated in the birth of the electric jazz fusion movement. In the 1970s, Corea founded the legendary jazz fusion group Return to Forever. Along with Herbie Hancock, McCoy Tyner and Keith Jarrett, Corea is one of the biggest modern jazz pianists.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: De Beren Gieren
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ogloc 5tetes
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lotus
programme.desc: Recorded in 1971 in Paris, France, Brazilian, classically trained bossa nova guitarist Baden Powell and his quartet play Pai, Lotus (written by Baden Powell), Tristeza (by Haroldo Lobo/Niltinho), Round Midnight (by Thelonious Monk), Nega do cabelo duro (by David Nasser/Rubens Soares), and Aos pes da cruz (by Zé da Zilda/Marino Pinto).

programme.title: Poinciana
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: The Art of Duo
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Crossroads: From Blues to Bossa
programme.desc: A two-part documentary, moderated by Dee Dee Bridgewater. Part 1: From Blues to Bossa On the search for the roots and origins of Jazz, we journey into the European and African music traditions and discover the cultural heritages of Jazz from Rio to New Orleans.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko & Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Portrait: Urgent Detergent
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Face au Public: Chuck Berry
programme.desc: No early breakthrough rock & roll artist is more important to the development of the genre than Chuck Berry (1926-2017). Influenced by jazz and rhythm and blues, he was rock & roll's greatest songwriter, the main shaper of its instrumental voice, one of its greatest guitarists, and one of its greatest performers.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and R&B genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat.

programme.desc: Filmed at Roundhouse, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Blondie performs her hits including ''Heart of Glass', 'Euphoria', ''Mile High' and many more….

programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Depeche Mode - Rock Am Ring
programme.desc: Rock Am Ring (Nürburgring), Rock Im Park (Nuremberg) is a music festival that takes place annually at the Nürburgring Race Track in western Germany. Featuring Depeche Mode.

programme.title: Radiohead - The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement
programme.desc: The King of Limbs: Live from the Basement is a 2011 live video album by the English alternative rock band Radiohead, performing their eighth album, The King of Limbs (2011).

programme.title: Toto - Falling In Between
programme.desc: This concert was recorded at Le Zenith in Paris in March 2007 in front of a wildly enthusiastic sell-out crowd. It captures Toto rocking at their hardest and most powerful and giving a new life to all their best loved tracks. The band formed in LA in the late 70's by a group of friends who were all much in demand session musicians.

programme.title: Beck - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Justin Bieber - Live at Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: The film follows the pop star Justin Bieber during 10 days counting down to his performance at Madison Square Garden. It also includes footage from his My World Tour, interviews with family and friends, a visit to his original hometown in Canada, and some of the story and videos of his childhood.

programme.title: Lady Gaga - Live in London 2013
programme.desc: Lady Gaga's performance at the iTunes Festival in London on September 1, 2013 marks the superstar's first full concert since the The Born This Way Ball. It is an eight song set containing the world premiere of seven tracks from her fourth album, ARTPOP: 'Aura'; 'MANiCURE'; 'Artpop'; 'Jewels N' Drugs' ft. T.I., Too $hort and Twista; 'Sexxx Dreams', 'Swine'; and 'I Wanna Be With You', a song that transformed into 'Dope' for ARTPOP.

programme.title: Paco de Lucía - Montreux 1987
programme.desc: Filmed July 15, 1987 at the famed Montreux Jazz Festival in Switzerland, Paco & John: Live At Montreux 1987 is a breathtaking evening of flamenco-infused jazz flair. The show opens with a solo piece from John McLaughlin, followed by a solo performance from Paco de Lucia, as if to showcase the stature of each virtuoso’s musicianship on their own merits.

programme.title: Paul McCartney - A MusiCaresTribute
programme.desc: The unmistakable Paul McCartney was honored as 'Person of the Year' by MusiCares at a gala event that brought together several artists to celebrate the Beatles' victorious career.

programme.title: Duran Duran - A Diamond In The Mind
programme.desc: A Diamond In The Mind Live was filmed at the MEN Arena in Manchester on December 16th 2011. This stunning Duran Duran live show is the perfect combination of great music, amazing visuals and iconic style which has been the band's trademark throughout their career. Following the release of their acclaimed 'All You Need Is Now' album, this concert combines new songs from that release with their classic hits.

programme.title: Pet Shop Boys - Live at Roskilde 2009
programme.desc: Filmed in Roskilde, Denmark, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Pet Shop Boys featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Always On My Mind', 'West End Girls', 'Being Boring' and many more...

programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: LL Cool J - Countdown Concert
programme.desc: James Todd Smith III, best known by the stage name of LL Cool J, is an American hip-hop artist and actor. He is best known for his romantic ballads.

programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Amigos para sempre T1 - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Eren, Seda, Merve e Yunus são quatro amigos que se conheceram há um ano, quando estudavam na universidade. No primeiro ano de aula, Seda conhece seu amigo de infância Gizem. Seda e Gizem, desde o primeiro momento se unem como antigamente estavam ligados um ao outro. Porém, os equilíbrios do grupo começam a mudar em breve.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 43
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.desc: Severide e Kidd recebem uma visita inesperada. Herrmann e Cindy renovam os seus votos. Mouch recebe notícias animadoras.

programme.title: The Rookie T8 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A Polícia de Los Angeles (LAPD), o FBI e a Interpol colaboram com Monica Stevens em Praga para localizar terroristas de alto risco.

programme.title: Nove Semanas e Meia
programme.desc: Elizabeth, assistente de galeria em Nova York, vive um intenso e turbulento romance erótico com John, um misterioso corretor de Wall Street. Entre jogos sexuais e dominação, Elizabeth perde o controlo sobre a sua vida e identidade.

programme.title: 28 Anos Depois
programme.desc: Um grupo de sobreviventes do vírus da raiva vive numa pequena ilha. Quando um dos membros do grupo deixa a ilha numa missão ao continente, descobre segredos, maravilhas e horrores que mutaram não só os infetados, mas também outros sobreviventes.

programme.title: Sonhar Com Leões
programme.desc: Sonhar com Leões é uma tragicomédia absurda sobre eutanásia e suicídio assistido. Gilda, uma imigrante brasileira que vive em Lisboa, chegou ao fim da linha. Professora de secundário reformada, com um humor sarcástico afiado como uma lâmina, tem apenas um ano de vida devido a um cancro maligno na medula espinal.

programme.title: A Melodia do Mal
programme.desc: Uma jovem compositora recebe a oportunidade da sua vida quando é encarregue de terminar o concerto do seu falecido mentor. Mas descobre que tocar a música traz consequências mortais, levando-a a descobrir as origens perturbadoras da melodia.

programme.title: Alma de Assassino
programme.desc: Um homem morre durante um programa militar experimental. É então que um veterano das operações especiais toma o seu lugar para descobrir quem o terá matado.

programme.title: Brincar com o Fogo
programme.desc: Após a morte da mulher, Pierre cria sozinho os filhos. Louis, o mais novo, destaca-se nos estudos, enquanto Fus aproxima-se de grupos de extrema-direita. Pierre vê, impotente, o filho afastar-se, num conflito onde o amor dá lugar à rebelião.

programme.title: Umas Férias à Força
programme.desc: Para escapar à polícia, pai e filho refugiam-se num campo de férias para jovens com deficiência, fazendo-se passar por um dos frequentadores do campo e um educador. Entre sarilhos e encontros improváveis, vivem uma experiência humana transformadora.

programme.title: April
programme.desc: Nina é obstetra-ginecologista num pequeno hospital na Geórgia. Após a morte de um recém-nascido durante o parto, a sua reputação profissional e moral é posta em causa. Rumores acusam-na de realizar abortos ilegais..

programme.title: Sing Sing
programme.desc: Divine G, preso injustamente, descobre um propósito ao atuar num grupo de teatro com outros reclusos, incluindo um recém-chegado mais cético. Uma comovente história verídica e um poderoso retrato de humanidade e do impacto transformador da arte.

programme.title: Emilia Pérez
programme.desc: Rita, uma advogada subvalorizada, recebe uma proposta inesperada: ajudar Manitas, líder de um cartel, a abandonar o crime e concretizar o seu plano secreto de anos – tornar-se a mulher que sempre sonhou ser.

programme.title: The Watchers - Eles Veem Tudo
programme.desc: Mina fica presa numa floresta isolada no oeste da Irlanda. Quando Mina encontra abrigo, sem saber, fica presa ao lado de três estranhos que são vigiados e perseguidos por criaturas misteriosas todas as noites. Não os podes ver, mas eles veem tudo.

programme.title: Mr. Burton
programme.desc: Baseado numa história verídica, “Mr. Burton” acompanha Richard Jenkins, filho de um mineiro galês, cuja vida muda ao conhecer um professor que o inspira a desafiar o destino e a tornar-se o lendário ator Richard Burton.

programme.title: Sem Refúgio
programme.desc: Um atirador profissional esgotado encontra-se preso numa penthouse toda em vidro por um concorrente letal e precisa encontrar uma maneira de sobreviver e escapar, com pouca ou nenhuma cobertura entre ele e o sniper assassino.

programme.title: Monstro Oculto
programme.desc: Willow, de 10 anos, questiona a vida isolada da família num complexo fortificado. Ao seguir os pais numa incursão noturna à floresta, Willow testemunha a terrível transformação do pai e vê-se enredada num obscuro segredo ancestral.

programme.title: Sei O Que Fizeste No Verão Passado
programme.desc: Cinco amigos encobrem um homicídio após um acidente mortal e juram silêncio. Um ano depois, alguém sabe o que fizeram. Perseguidos por um assassino armado com gancho, procuram ajuda junto dos sobreviventes do Massacre de Southport de 1997.

Ao mesmo tempo, é a história de uma esquecida vila portuguesa do interior que vai encontrar um novo fôlego com a reabertura de umas antigas minas de ouro. Tal como a protagonista, que irá passar das maiores provações às maiores riquezas.

Dada como morta, Verónica assume a identidade da irmã e deseja vingar-se da família do empresário.

programme.title: Entrelinhas - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Um olhar diferente sobre os mais diversos assuntos da atualidade para lhe explicar tudo que está escrito nas entrelinhas. Este é um programa de sucesso que revela todos os assuntos ao mais ínfimo pormenor. Em estúdio chegam histórias de quem um dia vivia sem esperança numa transformação.

programme.title: Eu Sou O Milagre - Ep. 109
programme.desc: A afirmação é para muitos uma expressão que exige verdade e coragem, contudo no programa Eu sou o Milagre poderá conhecer depoimentos de pessoas que passaram a ser o verdadeiro milagre.Na primeira pessoa entenderá que todos temos uma história que merece ser conhecida, sobretudo quando se alcança a superação através do poder da Fé. Ganhe coragem e motivação neste programa que mostra que tudo é possível àquele que crê.

programme.title: Decisão - Ep. 108
programme.desc: Tomar uma decisão nem sempre é uma tarefa fácil, sobretudo para quem se encontra imbuído de problemas existe o medo de se avançar um passo e se recuar dois. Mas neste programa é transmitida a força e coragem para se tomar a decisão, a melhor e mais certa em prol de um rumo digno de conquistas, superações e acontecimentos positivos. Tome a decisão de assistir a este programa que será um acrescento diário.

programme.title: Casos Reais - Ep. 152
programme.desc: A história de vida, de cada pessoa, do início ao fim. Nos Casos Reais vai conhecer histórias sem filtros, a mais pura verdade de cada vida, contada na primeira pessoa.O fim de uma doença, a recuperação do casamento, o desfecho feliz de perda, aqui irá conhecer os testemunhos de pessoas que contam como alcançaram a superação, através da fé!.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Lisboa - Ep. 22
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Não Desista - Ep. 152
programme.desc: Programa com casos reais de superação, abordando temas que ajudam a resolver problemas diários em diversas áreas da sua vida.

programme.title: Em Busca Do Amor - Ep. 153
programme.desc: O programa Em Busca do Amor ensina-lhe os segredos para um amor pleno e duradouro. Entender como resolver as divergências e alcançar a plenitude na relação, são diretrizes essenciais para quem já tem um casamento. Já para os solteiros são transmitidos conselhos de como escolher e desenvolver um bom relacionamento e assim como dicas de como ser um/a excelentes companheiros/as.

programme.title: Problemas Soluções - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Dificuldades e obstáculos todos teremos de enfrentar ao longo da vida, mas por vezes, estes são de tal forma graves que parecem não ter solução. Seja uma doença, um problema na família, no casamento, na vida financeira ou espiritual.Por vezes, as forças desaparecem e não parece haver luz ao fundo do túnel. Mas, acredite que para qualquer tipo de problema existe uma solução.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Porto - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Inveja, mau olhado, dores no corpo, depressão, azares que surgem sem razão aparente, têm muitas das vezes origem no oculto. Situações que a sociedade não sabe como resolver e permanece até que o pior aconteça. Contudo este é o programa que lhe mostra que não há limites para a fé e que tudo o que se encontra obscuro na vida, pode ser transformado.

programme.title: Algarve - Ep. 153
programme.desc: A partir do sul do país, o Programa do Algarve é produzido com o intuito de revelar histórias que desafiam a medicina, que ultrapassam e superam diagnósticos, que mostram como tudo é possível na vida daquele que crê.

programme.title: França - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Diretamente de França, este é um programa pensado para todas as pessoas que têm urgência em mudar e neste programa vão ter a oportunidade de conhecer casos reais de superação, abordando temas que ajudam a resolver problemas diários em diversas áreas da vida.

programme.title: Ponto De Luz Lisboa - Ep. 22
programme.desc: O programa mostra que não há limites para a fé. Todos os dias, casos verídicos de pessoas que superaram os seus problemas e hoje têm uma vida transformada.

programme.title: Vencendo Os Vícios - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Drogas, tabaco, jogo, pornografia são dos vícios que mais afetam a sociedade. Adições que levam inúmeras pessoas à falência, a perder empregos e ainda cortar os laços familiares e amizades. Assumir e superar nem sempre é uma atitude fácil de tomar por quem sofre com um vício, mas que neste programa poderá compreender o que pode ser feito para vencer de uma vez por todas, o vício, seja ele qual for.

programme.title: Coimbra - Ep. 153
programme.desc: Programa de Coimbra, remete-nos a uma cidade tão lusitana, que oferece a quem assiste uma esperança num amanhã melhor, com a transmissão de casos impressionantes de quem um dia tomou a atitude de confiar no poder da fé.

programme.desc: “Quero é Viver” é uma novela sobre o empoderamento feminino e a esperança. Com ternura e humor, narra a história de Ana e das suas quatro filhas que, depois da mãe de 70 anos terminar um casamento de 50, acabarão também por dar uma volta de 180 graus às suas próprias vidas.

programme.title: Inspetor Max

programme.title: Morangos Com Açúcar - Ep. 364

programme.title: V+ Futebol: Clássico
programme.desc: Seja dia de jogo ou não, esta vai ser, a partir de agora, a casa do futebol. Com uma programação pensada e dedicada, João Ricardo Pateiro leva até si relatos emocionantes dos jogos dos três maiores clubes portugueses –Benfica, Porto e Sporting. Vibre com cada lance, sinta a paixão dos adeptos em tempo real e viva o melhor de dois mundos: emoção e rigor, sempre com a máxima espetacularidade.

programme.title: V+ Fama
programme.desc: Se gosta de saber tudo o que acontece no mundo glamouroso das celebridades nacionais e internacionais, este programa é perfeito para si.O que tem acontecido nas vidas dos famosos? Quem esteve nas festas? Quem arranjou novo namoro ou terminou com o antigo? Tudo se vai descobrir neste programa. Além das reações no digital, vai haver comentários em estúdio e até ligação em direto com os protagonistas.
